name: back-overrides-monorepo
description: Smart endpoint interceptor and local redirector with automated CORS

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/core build && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/client build && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/cli build && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/mcp build
scripts.test: npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/core test && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/client test && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/cli test && npm run --workspace=@back-overrides/mcp test && npm run test:semver
